definition: Static counterfactual is D for all cities; observed tiers are analytical effect-size bins using R27 zero-aware FDR. Tiers are non-regulatory follow-up flags, not engineering hazard classes.
recommended_headline: Under the zero-aware BH screen, observed storage-derived water-table change moves 28 point-city exposure units from the static counterfactual into A/B follow-up tiers (6 material, 22 targeted; 19 increase-side and 9 depletion-side).
